items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: We was just playing and playing and we looked around and there was the bass up in there. He done fell off the stand.

ctx.x: And I'll never forget one time, we were playing at a theatre in Brooklyn and the Band had just got through playing there, you know, and they had stopped and Vic Dickenson jumped up and commenced to playing. Now see, he was high. Basie said, 'what's that . . . B-B-B- (laughs), what's he doing'. And then so they all had to commence to putting riffs behind him, you know, because they had ended; and then he just picked it up because he didn't know what they was playing cause he was out of it. That was the funniest…
